title: Generosity
definition: Generosity is the cheerful, sacrificial sharing of what God has entrusted for the good of others and the glory of Christ.
summary: Generosity is open-handed stewardship of resources, time, attention, and care for the glory of God and good of others.
christFocus: Jesus Christ became poor for our sake, and His grace teaches His people to give freely.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Generosity is the glad use of resources for God's glory and the good of others. Scripture presents generosity as a response to God's grace, not as a way to purchase His favor.

Generosity includes money, time, attention, hospitality, practical help, and mercy. It loosens the grip of greed and trains the heart to trust God's provision.

Jesus became poor for our sake and gave Himself fully. Christian generosity grows from beholding His gift before giving our own.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fear and greed can make people hold tightly to what God entrusted to them. Generosity teaches believers that possessions are tools for love, worship, and mission rather than masters of the heart.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Choose one concrete act of generosity this week. Give wisely and quietly where possible, support Gospel work, meet real needs, and ask God to free you from fear-driven hoarding.
